d: Within a few months in 2026, Pakistan and Türkiye signed two defence agreements. The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement with Saudi Arabia was signed in August, followed most recently by a separate Badr defence memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Qatar and Indonesia in October. The agreements signal both the consolidation of Ankara-Islamabad ties and the beginning of the two countries’ growing role as security providers across regions. ThePrint's Bantirani Patro argues in her column how Turkey and Pakistan are building defence ties that may look like a Muslim NATO in the making.
